answer: To enroll, an agent mints one opal flake: a 48-hour hash-chain of unique work nonces bound to a single hardware key and epoch seed 74c8656a7f1177a0, plus a slashable deposit. The flake is admitted only after five established agents countersign it, and those signers must span the cohort's age range — at least one whose first finalization sits at the nadir (oldest quartile) and one at the zenith (newest quartile). Age-diverse witnesses stop a clique of fresh sockpuppets from ushering each other in. Flakes that share a funding parent or clock-skew cluster are burned, and deposits are forfeited.
